subject: Cloud channel MAP kickoff: marketplace ops + partner roles
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: CloudScale Ops <ops@cloudscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Kickoff: Cloud channel MAP and evaluation plan

Hi all,

Thanks for getting this moving. Attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-v1.0.pdf) and a short evaluation plan we put together for CloudScale’s marketplace integration. Goal: establish roles, milestones, and a close timeline so procurement and marketplace onboarding align with the product evaluation windows.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm your operational contact for AWS marketplace onboarding (account team + Partner Ops).
- Agree on evaluation success criteria (latency SLA, monthly cost targets, integration test list).
- Lock an initial 6-week timeline with check-ins at weeks 1, 3, and 5.

Attachments: MAP-v1.0.pdf (draft MAP), security-reqs.xlsx (initial security questionnaire).

Proposed next step: 30–45m kickoff call Thu 2026-02-12 or Fri 2026-02-13. Please reply with availability and any additional stakeholders to add.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Rishi,

Thanks — appreciate the clear MAP. We (CloudScale Ops) will own the marketplace onboarding steps but need Partner Ops (AWS) involved for entitlement and listing timeline. I'm looping our cloud partnerships lead, Priya (priya@cloudscale.com), via separate email.

Quick answers:
- AWS Partner Ops contact: pending confirmation; will confirm Tue EOD.
- Evaluation criteria: will review security-reqs.xlsx with security; preliminary OK on data retention items, but we need clarification on audit log retention (see sheet row 12).

We can do Thu 02/12 at 1500 UTC or Fri 02/13 at 1400 UTC for the kickoff.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Marketplace Ops | CloudScale Inc
ops@cloudscale.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, CloudScale Ops <ops@cloudscale.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cloud channel MAP and evaluation plan

Thanks Diego and Rishi — jumping in with Redwood-side roles and a proposed milestone breakdown:

Redwood owners:
- Sales Lead & commercial: Marissa Cole (me) — negotiation, commercial timelines, pricing/credits.
- Technical lead: Soojin Lee — integration QA, marketplace packaging, test plan.
- Partner PM / coordination: Rishi Malhotra — MAP owner, meeting cadence.

Proposed milestones (6 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): MAP sign-off, partner ops contact confirmed.
2) Week 1: Test environment access + packaging checklist (aws-onboarding-checklist.docx).
3) Week 3: First integration smoke tests + security questionnaire answers updated.
4) Week 5: Marketplace listing staging, procurement thread initiated.
5) Week 6: Production listing + go/no-go final decision.

I’ll draft a concise procurement timeline to attach to the MAP before the kickoff call. If CloudScale can confirm the AWS Partner Ops contact by EOD 02/11 that would be ideal.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <aws-marketplace-partner@example.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudScale Ops <ops@cloudscale.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: AWS onboarding items and timeline

Hi Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. AWS Partner Ops here — typical onboarding pipeline and estimated durations:
- Entitlement & vendor verification: 3–5 business days after we get the signed vendor form and POC contact.
- Listing packaging review: 5 business days once artifacts submitted (AMI/container, listing copy).
- Staging verification + procurement enablement: 3 business days post-review.

Please upload the packaging artifacts to the secure link below and include the account owner (billing/procurement). Also send the redlined terms if you have them.

Upload link: https://aws.example.com/partner-upload/CS-4721

We’ll join the kickoff call and can run through the checklist in detail.

— AWS Marketplace Partner Ops
partner-ops@aws.example.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, CloudScale Ops <ops@cloudscale.com>, AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <aws-marketplace-partner@example.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:17:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Cloud channel MAP and evaluation plan

Appreciate the clarifications from AWS — a few technical notes ahead of the call:
- We’ll need staging tokens and test account credentials for the marketplace listing tests (please include expiry and scope).
- On the security sheet: we’ll update row 12 (audit log retention) to specify 90 days by default and an enterprise option for 1 year.
- Integration tests we plan to run: 1) model inference latency at 95th percentile, 2) cold-start times for containerized deployments, 3) KV/seq caching correctness. I’ll attach the test plan after this thread.

Below is a quick quote of AWS’s timing for context:
> AWS Partner Ops: Entitlement & vendor verification: 3–5 business days after we get the signed vendor form and POC contact.

Proposed call time: Thu 2026-02-19 16:00 UTC (push out 1 week to allow procurement docs and redlines). If that works for everyone I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Principal Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Subject: Final MAP (v1.1) and confirmed next steps

Team — thanks for the fast responses. I’ve updated the MAP to v1.1 (attached) reflecting: AWS timeline notes, audit log retention (90d default), and our milestone dates (see milestones in the MAP). Summary of agreed next steps:

1) CloudScale: confirm Partner Ops contact (Priya) and upload procurement owner to HubSpot (link below).
2) Redwood: finalize packaging artifacts and upload to AWS partner portal by 2026-02-20.
3) AWS: start vendor verification once vendor form & POC received.
4) All: join kickoff call Thu 2026-02-19 16:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.

Attachments: MAP-v1.1.pdf (final for kickoff), aws-onboarding-checklist.docx (packaging checklist).

If nobody objects, I’ll mark the MAP as agreed and start the procurement thread.

Best,
Rishi
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
